lines.trans: Yes, I'm Titus.
Today is my first day here.
I don't know the others very well yet.
But I'm not here to make friends.
I'm here to earn money.
Of course! Come here, kid.
I've been searching the whole shop for you! We have a real problem.
Sabine is coming any minute! Could you please go to the checkout?
And you two tidy up the stockroom! I can't believe this.
